name: Creobel
summary:
Creobel is a permadeath action RPG with online co-op multiplayer for 1-4 players.
Players gather materials while fighting off enemies to craft powerful new equipment, which keeps them alive as they move on to tougher areas.
Creobel has a wide range of weapons to master and plenty of equipment to enhance your character. Survive through three biomes with distinct themes and enemy behaviours, each ending with a boss fight!
